Phase 1 needs a loop that is fast: seconds, not minutes. One run here takes about 40 minutes
and small inputs come out right, so there is no tight loop to build, and the skill is clear
that without one there is no Phase 2.

So I am stopping here, as "When you genuinely cannot build a loop" says. What I considered:
a failing test (small inputs pass, so it cannot go red) and a differential run against an
older version (40 minutes per side).

To go further I need one of:
(a) access to an environment that holds the full dataset and can run it,
(b) a redacted log from a run that dropped cells, or
(c) permission to add temporary instrumentation to the production pipeline.
